items.title: Mortgage rates hit a 13-month high as an Iran conflict rattles the bond market
items.note: 30-year fixed climbs to 6.71% on a Treasury yield spike, not Fed policy

items.title: Investor share of single-family home purchases slips to 27%
items.note: Cotality: mega-investor pullback ahead of new housing law trims Q2 volume by ~40,000 homes

items.title: Israeli AI agents company Wonderful raises $550M at a $5B valuation

items.title: Salesforce leads a $166M round in Israeli HR platform HiBob

items.title: Israeli cloud security startup Upwind raises $300M at a $3.8B valuation
